name: V6 epistemic-search cohort: Gen 15 lineages re-run with the gene on (Benchmark A)
design: within-genome A/B of epistemic_policy.enabled against the Gen 15 (V5) trajectories; no breeding, so the gene is the only variable
objective: Implement the 4 core self-hosting modules of the Hierarchical Agent Evolution (HAE) engine: hae/evaluation/artifacts.py, hae/evaluation/harness.py, hae/evaluation/verification_loop.py, hae/genome/morphogenesis.py
notes: Seeds are replicas of one genome under distinct company ids (<id>__s1..s3): the search rng is derived from the company id and the sampler is stochastic, so replicas are independent draws of the same firm.

Controls are the two Gen 15 convergers: pareto_1 converged at iteration 1 (never opens a ledger; exercises the V5 composite path under the V6 build) and mutant_3 converged at iteration 2 (one easy repair; checks V6 does not make an easy repair harder).
Everything else is byte-identical to the Gen 14 genome that ran in Gen 15: same task file, model, budgets, max_iterations=5.
